children: "The biggest risk that I see with inflation right now is that an inflationary mindset could start to set in."
- Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack at a Friday panel explaining why she thinks monetary policy should take a "restrictive stance" to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% target at a Friday.
